name: CTClossV3

y.description: Per-sample CTC loss, shape (N) or scalar

description: The Connectionist Temporal Classification loss. Calculates loss between a continuous time series and a target sequence. Supports 3D (T,N,C) and 2D (T,C) log_probs with int64/int32 targets. blank is the blank label index (default 0). zero_infinity zeros out infinite losses. reduction='none' returns per-sample loss.
